content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 24 satisfies every preferred ASSIGN element:

- **§ 24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor's consent (prompt notice only, with assignee assumption).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (reasonableness standard runs our way), and cannot assign to a direct Customer competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — residual mutual consent gate, not unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.
- **§ 24.4** — Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right; the walk-away trigger is absent.
- **§ 13.3** — licence rights follow a permitted assignment, so no orphaned licence on an M&A exit.

Noted but not redlined (minor sub-elements only): the competitor bar carries a "without Customer's consent" tail, which is immaterial because no Vendor assignment is permitted without our consent in any event; and § 24.2's consent standard omits "conditioned or delayed," which § 24.3 supplies for other assignments.
